_comment_actor: Use Apify Actor: compass/crawler-google-places (the maintained Google Maps Scraper).
_comment_usage: Paste this JSON into the Actor's 'Input' tab in Apify Console. Adjust searchStringsArray for your niche/city.
_comment_rate_limit: Apify auto-handles Google rate limits; do NOT set concurrency above 8 on the free plan.
_comment_retry: Retries handle 'incomplete data' / timeouts from Google's UI.
_comment_proxy: Residential proxy reduces 'temporarily blocked' results. Free tier = use datacenter group.
_comment_webhook: After Actor finishes, send results to n8n. Replace the URL with your n8n webhook URL.
_comment_webhook_setup: In Apify Console → Actor → Integrations → Webhooks → Add → Event 'ACTOR.RUN.SUCCEEDED' → URL = https://<your-n8n>/webhook/leads-ingest
